name: apache-ant
title: apache-ant-1.10.17
summary: The Apache Ant package is a Java -based build tool. In theory, it is like the make command, but without make 's wrinkles. Ant is different. Instead of a model that is extended with shell-based commands, Ant is extended using Java classes. Instead of writing shell commands, the configuration files are XML-based, calling out a target tree that executes various tasks. Each task is run by an object that implements a particular task interface.
